The '''''Diligent''''' was a [[PB-950 patrol boat]], commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Corran Costi]], a member of the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Law" />
